invariants.rationale: The method attempts to load and return a TiledMap, and on failure throws an exception instead of returning null.
tideFile is passed directly to loadMap and used for map loading, so it must not be null.
assetManager is used to construct AssetManagerImageResolver, so it must not be null.
fileName is referenced in the exception construction for error reporting.
fileName is used as an identifier and error message; it is likely expected to be non-empty.
